NONE: › a soft leather shoe that you slide onto your foot and do not fasten, that has stitches around the top at the front
莫卡辛軟皮鞋，無後跟軟幫皮鞋
› a type of coffee of good quality
摩卡咖啡，莫加咖啡
› a mixture of coffee and chocolate, or a flavouring that tastes of this
巧克力咖啡飲料
› formal to laugh at someone, often by copying them in a funny but unkind way
嘲笑，嘲弄；（常指為取笑而）模仿
› to make something appear stupid or not effective
愚弄；使徒勞，挫敗
› not real but appearing or pretending to be exactly like something
假的；仿製的；假裝的
› an exam taken at school for practice before a real exam
模擬考試

example: They were mocking him because he kept falling off his bike.
他們不斷嘲笑他，因為他老是從腳踏車上摔下來。
She made fun of him by mocking his limp.
她模仿他一瘸一拐地走路來取笑他。
The wind mocked their attempts to reach the shore by pushing the boat further and further out to sea.
風把船往海裡刮得越來越遠，使他們靠岸的努力落空。
You will have your mocks during the first two weeks of March.
你們將在三月份的頭兩個星期進行模擬考試。

NONE: › to make a model of something in order to show people what it will look like or how it will work
模擬；用模型展示
› a high, round collar that does not fold over on itself, or a piece of clothing with this type of collar
高圓領；高圓領針織衫
› A mock-Tudor house is a modern house that is built in a historical style.
（形容模仿歷史風格的現代住宅）仿都鐸王朝建築風格的
› a full-size model of something large that has not yet been built, showing how it will look or operate
實體模型，實尺寸模型

example: She showed us a mock-up of what the car will look like when it goes into production.
她向我們展示了投產後的汽車的實體模型。

NONE: › to spoil something or stop it from happening
破壞；使告吹

example: It rained, so that rather put the mockers on the barbecue.
下雨了，我們的露天燒烤告吹了。

U: › [ U ] the act of mocking someone or something
S: › [ S ] an action or event that seems stupid and without value

example: Bill's mockery of his dad was cruel, but it made us laugh.
比爾模仿他爸爸的做法有點殘忍，不過我們都被逗笑了。
The trial was a mockery - the judge had decided the verdict before it began.
這次審判為人恥笑——法官在審判開始前就作出了判決。

NONE: › mocking behaviour involves laughing at someone or something in an unkind way
嘲笑的，嘲弄的
› any of various types of North American or Australian birds that copy the sounds made by other birds
嘲鶇（北美或澳大利亞的鳥類，善模仿其他鳥的叫聲）
› pronunciation of English by someone who pretends to speak like a cockney, in order to seem as if they are from a lower social class
（為使自己看起來像來自較低社會階層而裝出的）模仿倫敦土話
› a film or television show made in the style of a documentary to make invented events seem real
模擬紀錄片，模仿紀錄片
